title: CPB Registry Snapshot
description: Machine-readable snapshot of the CPB Payload Canonicalization Algorithm and Artifact Type registries. Generated from REGISTRY.md by .github/gen_registry.py. The snapshot_sha256 field is the SHA-256 of the document body (all fields except snapshot_sha256 itself) serialized as compact JSON with keys sorted. Recomputing it checks internal consistency; authenticity requires comparison with an independently trusted digest or a trusted distribution channel.

schema_version.description: Schema version for forward-compatibility. Bump when the shape changes in a non-backward-compatible way.

snapshot_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the document body (all fields except this one) as compact JSON with sorted keys.

canonicalization_algorithms.description: Payload Canonicalization Algorithm Registry (§13.1). Keys are algorithm identifiers.

status.description: Legal values are NOT enumerated here. The vocabulary lives in REGISTRY.md's Entry Status Vocabulary table plus its legacy mapping, and gen_registry.py validates against it by parsing that table. A second list here could only drift from the first; JSON Schema cannot read REGISTRY.md, so it checks shape and leaves vocabulary to the generator.

discriminating_vector.description: Verbatim text of the '⌙ Discriminating-vector:' line, when present. Presence only; content is Designated Expert judgment (Gate A), not validated here.

consuming_profile.description: Verbatim text of the '⌙ Consuming-profile:' line, when present. Presence only; content is Designated Expert judgment (Gate B), not validated here.

artifact_types.description: Artifact Type Registry (§13.2). Keys are artifact type names.

discriminating_vector.description: Verbatim text of the '**Discriminating-vector:**' prose line, when present. Presence only; content is Designated Expert judgment (Gate A), not validated here.

consuming_profile.description: Verbatim text of the '**Consuming-profile:**' prose line, when present. Presence only; content is Designated Expert judgment (Gate B), not validated here.
